decisions.difference: A: (clinical_finding Pain (finding_site Skin structure))  vs  B: (clinical_finding Pain of skin)
decisions.reason: "PAINFUL SKIN" maps directly to the precoordinated finding Pain of skin, which exists (A's note that it doesn't was wrong); applied to every diagnosis rule's pain condition too.

decisions.difference: A: Recurrent abscess of skin + Abscess of axilla / Abscess of groin / Abscess of perineum (4 items)  vs  B: Recurrent abscess of skin with finding_site Axillary region / Inguinal region / Perineal structure (3 items)
decisions.final_expr: (clinical_finding (snomed_concept "Recurrent abscess of skin" "disorder") (finding_site (snomed_concept "Axillary region structure" "body structure"))) …Inguinal region structure… …Perineal structure…
decisions.reason: "If recurrent boils or abscesses: If painful abscesses in axilla, groin or perineum" ties recurrence to the site; B's one finding carries both, A's separate findings let recurrence elsewhere plus one axillary abscess fire.

decisions.difference: Hidradenitis rule: A: Pain + Recurrent abscess of skin + (or Abscess of axilla/groin/perineum)  vs  B: Pain of skin + (or Recurrent abscess of skin at axilla/inguinal/perineal site)
decisions.reason: Same reason as the check_for decision: the page nests the sites under the recurrence.

decisions.difference: A: Blister of skin (qualifier Zosteriform) (qualifier Unilateral)  vs  B: Blister of skin (finding_site Dermatome) (qualifier Unilateral)
decisions.reason: "In a band along one side" describes a distribution pattern, which a pattern qualifier (Zosteriform) expresses more closely than a body-site; neither is literal, so unsettled.

decisions.difference: Herpes zoster rule blister: same as the check_for difference (Zosteriform vs Dermatome)
decisions.reason: Kept identical to the check_for item so the task collects the rule's evidence.

decisions.difference: Cellulitis and erysipelas rules: A requires Pain (skin) and plain Erythema in addition to the qualified Erythema, warm, swollen; B has only qualified Erythema, Warm skin, Swelling of skin
decisions.final_expr: (and (clinical_finding (snomed_concept "Pain of skin" "finding")) (clinical_finding Erythema (qualifier Poorly defined | Well defined + Raised)) (clinical_finding Warm skin) (clinical_finding Swelling of skin))
decisions.reason: Pain kept (as Pain of skin) because both panels sit under the page complaint "PAINFUL SKIN" though their stem says only "Red, warm, swollen skin" (unsettled); A's plain Erythema dropped as redundant with the qualified Erythema that already encodes "Red".

decisions.difference: Boil/abscess rule pain: A: Pain (finding_site Skin structure)  vs  B: Pain of skin
decisions.reason: "painful lump" on the skin; same precoordinated concept as the trigger.

notes: Both builds passed. Base is B (correct precoordinated Pain of skin; recurrence tied to site for hidradenitis); A's Zosteriform form adopted for the shingles blister, and pain required in all five diagnosis rules. Rule descriptions follow B. Diagnoses identical in both builds. Red box is pointer-only (cross_reference_only), no priority evaluation; Refer-same-day lists are management. diff.json counts each repeated pain condition separately; they are covered by the trigger and boil/abscess decisions above.
